messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert - HIGH - gcp-ilb-route-err. Multiple Private VPC deployments reporting 502/504 and inconsistent cross-region routing. Suspected GCP control-plane API errors affecting ILB route propagation.

pagerduty: Paging oncall: Maria G. (SRE) — please ACK and start triage.

Maria G.: acked — I'm on. seeing customer reports from eu-west1 -> traffic suddenly egressing to us-central1. error spikes at the ILB layer, lots of 502/504s.

Raj P.: I can join. checking GCP console — health checks for several backend services show transient failures, control-plane API calls returning 503s and 429s intermittently. this looks like rate-limited route propagation + ILB control plane degradation.

Alex K.: Datadog also shows a delay in GCP LB metrics (missing datapoints for ~2m). logs from stackdriver are delayed as well. might take a few mins for full visibility.

Joan L.: product/support: got inbound from 3 enterprise Private VPC customers in EU. telling them we're investigating, will update ETA in 30m. they see app errors and increased tail latency.

Maria G.: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause cross-region failover policies that are triggering broad rebalancing; 2) force regional backend pool preference for affected customers; 3) roll traffic to backup regional ILBs where possible. executing step 1 now.

Raj P.: copy. if GCP API is flaky, making many control-plane writes will just worsen. prefer minimal writes: update one policy per-project, avoid mass changes.

Maria G.: running command to set backend service failover policy to prefer-local for project redwood-prod-eu:

```bash
gcloud compute backend-services update be-service-eu --global --locality-lb-policy=FAILOVER --region=eu-west1
```

Maria G.: applied to 2 affected projects. watching metrics.

Alex K.: logs: got a stream that shows GCP returning "503 Control plane not available" around 15:02:13 and then 429s after 15:03. suggests API throttling.

Joan L.: customers updated. first response is positive — two report errors dropping after ~90s. keep me posted, will coordinate follow-up comms and severity.

Raj P.: observed routing table inconsistencies in peering for a couple Private VPCs — some propagated routes removed then reappeared. trying a small, conservative route re-insert for one affected VPC to see if it stabilizes.

Maria G.: note — avoid touching global forwarding rules for now, that's noisy. focusing on per-project backend policy toggles.

incident-bot: Incident timeline entry created: incident/ILB-GCP-API-2026-03-15. Severity: P1 (customer-impacting).

Maria G.: after failover policy change, errors dropped from 12% -> 1.5% over 4 mins for eu-west1 customers. metrics still noisy due to delayed ingestion but trending OK.

Raj P.: handing to me for next steps and follow-up runbook items — Maria, do you want to H/T?

Maria G.: Handoff: Maria -> Raj. I'm 1-on-1 for 10m then shift to support for comms. Raj, please take lead on mitigation timeline and postmortem.

Raj P.: taking lead. immediate next actions: 1) validate all affected Private VPCs have prefer-local policy; 2) open GCP support case referencing control-plane API 503/429; 3) schedule a short maintenance window to bump healthcheck timeouts on ILBs to reduce flapping; 4) draft customer impact summary for ops.

Joan L.: I'll assemble the customer impact table with timestamps + affected regions and escalate to account teams.

Alex K.: note for follow-up: Datadog/Stackdriver ingestion delay -> correlate with GCP API timestamps when building timeline. save raw logs where available.

Maria G.: status update: PagerDuty keepalive. if errors stay <=2% for next 10m we'll move to monitoring state and prepare RCA.

Raj P.: opened GCP support case 20260315-ILB-CTRL-01 — included sample control-plane traces, error codes 503/429 and affected project IDs. GCP acknowledged and flagged as internal control-plane incident.

Joan L.: customer comms draft ready. waiting for final confirmation to send.

Maria G.: final note before I drop: avoid broad automated retries on control-plane APIs; we should prefer policy toggles that are low-churn. thanks team for quick responses. :rocket:

Raj P.: thanks Maria. I'll stay on until handoff to next shift. follow-ups: postmortem, runbook update (add guidance for GCP control-plane API throttles), and contact list for impacted customers.

incident-bot: Incident state updated to 'mitigated — monitoring'. Actions required: postmortem within 72h, customer update in 1h.

Joan L.: sending customer update now. closing thread after postmortem checkins. :white_check_mark:
